entries.summary: Migrated GD edit form CSS/JS overlay from Code Snippets into class-oha-hld-gd-form.php
entries.notes: Snippet oha-gd-single-form-ui must be DEACTIVATED after this update. Enqueue at priority 99 on is_gd_form_page() only.

entries.summary: Haunt owner discount edit section on GD frontend listing form
entries.notes: Owner or admin only. Fields: active, rate, message, link, start, end. Injected via wp_footer priority 5 then moved into form by JS before fieldset processing so collapsible behavior applies automatically. Nonce: oha_disc_frontend_save.

entries.summary: Discount change history logging and board email notification on frontend save
entries.notes: _oha_disc_history meta: max 10 entries, records date/user/status/rate/message/source. Board notified via wp_mail to claim_email_recipients option or admin_email fallback.

entries.summary: Utilities tab: absorbed gd-core-autocomplete-enhancer and gd-place-count-extended into HLD
entries.notes: Deactivate gd-core-autocomplete-enhancer and gd-place-count-extended once this version is active. Settings: enable_autocomplete, enable_place_count stored in oha_hld_settings.

entries.summary: Standalone autocomplete had unregistered gd_autocomplete_locations AJAX action - now correctly registered
entries.notes: Silent bug in the original gd-core-autocomplete-enhancer plugin - both keyword and location handlers now registered in HLD.

entries.summary: Discount/Deal admin meta box fields on gd_place edit screens (_oha_disc_* keys)
entries.notes: Fields: active, rate, message, link, start, end, bg, color. Same meta keys read by [oha_discounts] shortcode. Admins can manage discount data from listing edit screen.

entries.summary: Added Requires Plugins: geodirectory to plugin header (WP 6.5+ dependency declaration)
oha-home-haunt-hub integration: Hub listings display through HLD template with oha_hh_* meta fallbacks
entries.notes: Mapped: scare_level->fear_level, age_rec->age_restriction, years_running, scene_count, facebook, email, style[]->features. Hub-exclusive: operating_nights, public_visitors, visitor_range_label, builders_notes. No Hub plugin changes required.

entries.summary: Business hours not showing: geodir_get_business_hours() keys are full day names, not abbreviations
entries.notes: API returns ['days']['Monday'...] with 'closed' bool + 'slots'[]['range'] (pre-formatted string). Completely rewrote sidebar rendering to match actual API.

entries.summary: Email anti-spam: reveal-on-click button replaces plain mailto link in sidebar info card
entries.notes: Email split at @ into data-u / data-d attributes. JS assembles mailto on first click. No full address in HTML source.

entries.summary: GD email and business_hours fields displayed in sidebar (email row + weekly hours table)
entries.notes: Today's hours row highlighted dark-red. Times formatted 12-hour. haunt_theme field now rendered as Theme row above Phone.

entries.summary: Video oEmbed not rendering for plain YouTube/Vimeo URLs
entries.notes: Replaced wp_embed->autoembed() with wp_oembed_get() as primary, autoembed with post_ID as secondary, wp_kses_post for raw iframe. Regex guard prevents oEmbed on non-URL strings.

entries.summary: Gallery thumbnails blurry: changed from medium (300px) to large src for background-image
Lightbox CSS added; image preloader with loading state; touch/swipe mobile navigation
entries.notes: Swipe threshold 40px, horizontal-only.

entries.summary: Video section: reads GD video field, converts YouTube/Vimeo via oEmbed, 16:9 responsive wrapper
_oha_hld_override_claimed meta: suppresses unclaimed display state from WP admin meta box
entries.notes: Shown in admin info panel as 'Owner-managed (admin override)' status.

entries.summary: Admin info panel: added Edit (Frontend) and Edit (WP Admin) buttons
entries.notes: Frontend edit uses GD gd_action=edit_post URL.

entries.summary: Field Reference tab in admin: all GD custom fields for gd_place with live value preview by post ID
Nearby haunts: featured-only, haversine distance sort, distance badge. Section renamed to Featured Haunts Nearby.
Full Track B field reads: 20+ GD custom fields, discount meta, is_display_unclaimed flag, gallery fix
entries.notes: Discount meta: _oha_disc_*. Gallery now shows all images, not just 2+. is_display_unclaimed: author=3 && !claimed.

entries.summary: Hero badges, unclaimed state, fear level pill, haunt type pill; main-content features, stats, visitor tips, recruiting
Claim section replaced button_html() with section_html(): full context-aware rendering for all owner states
entries.notes: States: admin info panel, author You Own This, real-user claimed hidden, unclaimed claim prompt.

entries.summary: Admin settings page with Display and Claim tabs under GeoDirectory > OHA Listing Display
Integrated claim workflow: hidden CPT, AJAX submit, approve/reject, email notifications, pending count badge
entries.notes: Compatible with gd-claim-via-reports meta keys. Deactivate gd-claim-via-reports when using HLD.

entries.summary: Initial plugin: GD single listing template override with hero, 2-col layout, gallery, nearby, OHA dark theme CSS
entries.notes: Template: content-single.php + partials. Override via geodir_overwrite_single_template_content filter.

entries.summary: Tiered discount bar: promo code and private link visible to OHA paid members only
entries.notes: PHP-gated: promo code and private link never appear in HTML source for non-members. Member check uses oha_member_id usermeta (canonical for all active members). Teaser shown to non-members with smart join link: basic members go to /my-membership/, non-logged-in go to /register/.

entries.summary: Promo code and private link fields added to HLD admin meta box and GD frontend owner edit form
entries.notes: Meta keys: _oha_disc_promo_code (sanitize_text_field), _oha_disc_private_link (esc_url_raw). Saved in both class-oha-hld-admin.php save_meta_box() and class-oha-hld-gd-form.php save_discount().

entries.summary: Moved discount notice above the hero image for immediate visibility on page load
entries.notes: Block now renders before include hero.php in content-single.php (Option D positioning).

entries.summary: Redesigned discount notice as two-column card with OHA Member Discount label and 30px rate text
entries.notes: Removed __inner/__icon elements. New structure: __card (flex row), __main (left col with label+rate+msg), __members (right col, vertical gold divider). Rate 14px gold -> 30px white Cinzel. Label is Cinzel small caps gold. Members uses __members-header wrapper. Mobile stacks at 600px.

entries.summary: Moved discount card back below the hero image
entries.notes: Reverted v1.9.0 positioning change. Discount notice now renders after hero.php, before .oha-listing-body.

entries.summary: Social buttons switched to 2-column grid with white-space:nowrap to prevent text wrapping
entries.notes: Changed .oha-social from display:flex to display:grid with repeat(2,1fr). Added white-space:nowrap and tightened padding on .oha-social__btn. Removed flex:1 (not needed in grid context).

entries.summary: Discount rate badge shown on nearby featured haunt cards when discount is active
entries.notes: Reads _oha_disc_active, _oha_disc_rate, _oha_disc_start, _oha_disc_end per nearby card. Badge shows rate + Member Discount label below title. Uses  from parent content-single.php scope. CSS class: .oha-nearby__discount (gold, Rajdhani, subtle border).

entries.summary: Autocomplete dropdown: white text on white bg fixed by scoping color to .ui-autocomplete
entries.notes: Added color:#111 to .ui-autocomplete .ui-menu-item-wrapper; scoped both ui-menu-item-wrapper rules under .ui-autocomplete to avoid bleeding into other jQuery UI menus

entries.summary: Autocomplete now loads sitewide, not only on haunt-list page
entries.notes: Changed enqueue_autocomplete guard from is_search/is_page check to is_admin only; JS self-guards with length check so no-ops on pages without GD search forms

entries.summary: Autocomplete no longer attaches to WP native search input[name=s]
entries.notes: JS now scopes to form:has(input[name=snear]) so only GD search forms get autocomplete, not the WP search widget

entries.summary: Autocomplete AJAX calls are now lazy, firing on first focus instead of page load
entries.notes: Used .one focus handler; race condition handled by calling autocomplete search immediately after attach if input already has 2+ chars

entries.summary: Autocomplete AJAX responses cached with 1-hour transient to avoid per-request DB queries
entries.notes: Keys: oha_hld_ac_keywords and oha_hld_ac_locations; locations callback skips caching if GD table missing

entries.summary: Add OHA Discount sort option to GeoDirectory place search with admin toggle in Utilities tab
entries.notes: Hooks: geodir_add_custom_sort_options, posts_join, geodir_custom_key_orderby. One-time setup: drag OHA Discount tile in GD Admin > Places > Sorting, set DESC. Toggle off hides option from frontend dropdown via geodir_get_sort_options filter.

entries.summary: Guard against duplicate JOIN alias on multi-loop pages; hide sort option from dropdown when disabled
entries.notes: discount_sort_join checks strpos for oha_disc_pm before adding. maybe_hide_discount_sort_option always registered so stale DB entry cannot show broken sort.

entries.summary: Remove post_type guard from discount_sort_join that blocked JOIN on GD search pages causing zero results
entries.notes: GD search pages do not set post_type on WP_Query; guard caused JOIN to be skipped while ORDER BY still referenced oha_disc_pm alias, producing MySQL error and empty results. sort_by guard alone is sufficient.

entries.summary: Add unclaimed listing placeholder text system with 8 admin-editable templates and optional discount line
entries.notes: Templates use {name} and {city} tokens; selection is deterministic by listing ID mod count; discount line appended when show_discount is true and disc_rate is set; toggle and textarea in Display Settings tab of HLD admin

entries.summary: Fix attraction_website field key so haunt website URLs now display on listing pages
entries.notes: GD field htmlvar_name is attraction_website not website; content-single.php now reads attraction_website first with fallback to built-in website field

entries.summary: Fix attraction_phone_number field key so haunt phone numbers now display on listing pages
entries.notes: GD field htmlvar_name is attraction_phone_number not phone; content-single.php now reads attraction_phone_number first with fallback to built-in phone field

entries.summary: Move Visit Website from CTA button group to full-width red button below address in info card
entries.notes: Removed from oha-cta-buttons group and from info card text row; new oha-info-card__website-btn added to sidebar.php and listing.css

entries.summary: Add search bar partial to single listing pages with OHA dark theme and autocomplete support
entries.notes: New templates/partials/search-bar.php outputs compact GD-compatible form (input[name=s] + input[name=snear]). Submits to geodir_search_page_base_url(). Autocomplete attaches automatically via existing gd-autocomplete.js. CSS in listing.css uses Kadence global palette vars.

entries.summary: Add archive.css OHA dark theme layer for GD archive and search results pages (places + events)
entries.notes: New assets/archive.css. All rules scoped to body.oha-gd-archive. Targets .geodir-post cards (both legacy section layout and Bootstrap block-based .card wrapper). Styles: card bg/border/hover, image, body, title, meta, footer, badges, rating, sort controls, pagination, no-results, autocomplete dropdown. Covers gd_place and gd_event.

entries.summary: Enqueue archive.css and add oha-gd-archive body class on GD archive, search, and listing pages
entries.notes: Two new hooks in oha-haunt-listing-display.php: wp_enqueue_scripts enqueues archive.css; body_class filter adds oha-gd-archive. Both check geodir_is_page archive/search/listing. Scoping via body class prevents bleed into non-GD pages.

entries.summary: Fixed pagination CSS: a.page-numbers and span.page-numbers selectors now target links not the ul wrapper
entries.notes: GD paginate_links(type=list) outputs ul.page-numbers containing a.page-numbers and span.page-numbers; previous rule hit the ul causing no styling on links

entries.summary: Broadened archive search form CSS to cover form[name=geodir-listing-search] in addition to .geodir-loc-bar
entries.notes: GD block-based search widget may not use .geodir-loc-bar class; both selectors now targeted for consistent dark theme input styling

entries.summary: Moved search bar above hero on single listing pages for consistent placement with /places/ search bar
entries.notes: search-bar.php include moved from after .oha-listing-body to before hero.php; bar is now first element inside .oha-listing-wrap

entries.summary: Restyled listing page search bar as thin compact top bar to match /places/ page style
entries.notes: Removed card box and padding from .oha-search-bar; now a slim full-width bar with bottom border above the hero; label hidden

entries.summary: Forced 3-column CSS Grid layout on archive pages overriding Bootstrap row-cols-sm-2 default
entries.notes: Bootstrap md breakpoint (768px) fails when Kadence sidebar narrows content area; replaced with explicit CSS Grid on .geodir-category-list-view: 3col desktop, 2col tablet, 1col mobile

entries.summary: Archive cards restyled to match nearby-haunt card design: dark bg, gold hover, fixed 160px image, Cinzel title
entries.notes: Card bg changed from #000 to #111, border changed from red-tint to subtle light border, hover changed from red to gold, image fixed at 160px with object-fit cover, body uses flex-column with gap, matching oha-nearby__card layout

entries.summary: OHA Discount badge added to archive cards via post_class filter and CSS ::after on .card-body
entries.notes: PHP post_class filter adds oha-has-discount to archive posts with active in-date discount; CSS ::after on .card-body shows gold Member Discount badge matching oha-nearby__discount style

entries.summary: Fixed gap appearing between search form and card grid after performing a search
entries.notes: GD Gutenberg block wrappers carry white backgrounds by default; added background:transparent rule on [class*=wp-block-geodirectory] and related GD containers

entries.summary: Pagination text now explicitly white (#f7fafc) with li in selector chain for higher specificity
entries.notes: Previous selectors lacked li intermediate; theme or Bootstrap may override with dark text; added li a.page-numbers and explicit color:#f7fafc !important

entries.summary: Listing page search bar now stretches full width; inputs have red border and focus glow
entries.notes: Removed max-width:860px from .oha-search-bar__row; added hover and focus border+glow states for better visibility without looking retro

entries.summary: Show actual discount rate on archive cards instead of generic Member Discount text
entries.notes: wp_footer injects inline script with post-id to rate JSON map; JS appends .oha-arc-disc-badge span to .card-body on each .oha-has-discount card; GD data-post-id attr is the bridge; CSS ::after approach removed in archive.css

entries.summary: Set 12 posts per page on GD place pages so 3-column grid fills evenly (was 10)
entries.notes: geodir_posts_per_page filter covers GD block queries; pre_get_posts covers main query on search results page. Both hooks needed since GD uses two different query paths.

entries.summary: Reset white article/entry-content background on GD search results page to match archive layout
entries.notes: Search results page uses default Kadence article template with white bg; archive page is full-width with no white box. Added background:transparent to article, .entry-content, .geodir-search, .gd-search-bar in archive.css scoped to body.oha-gd-archive.

tabs: Display Settings: feature toggles (claim, report, gallery, nearby, mobile bar), nearby count
Claim Settings: heading/body/button text, email from/recipients, submit email, approval email
Pending Claims: approve/reject queue with pending count badge
Field Reference: all GD custom fields for gd_place, with live value preview by post ID

v1.0.0_audit_corrections.correct_value: Comma , separator (confirmed from implode(",",$value) in save logic)
